earnings.title: HOUSTON, October 28, 2026 – Phillips 66 (NYSE: PSX) announced third-quarter earnings.
highlights: Returned $2.8 billion to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases

quotes.text: Phillips 66 delivered strong operating performance in the third quarter and is executing on its financial and operating commitments.
quotes.by: Mark Lashier, chairman and CEO of Phillips 66

items.heading: Margins for the products we produce are cyclical and volatile due to changes in market conditions, which are largely dependent on factors beyond our control, and directly affect our earnings, financial condition and cash flows.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Manufacturing and Operations

items.heading: The prices at which we buy our feedstocks are dependent on market conditions that are beyond our control, and changes in supply and demand for the feedstocks we process directly impact the results of our business.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Manufacturing and Operations

items.heading: Changes to government policies relating to renewable feedstocks and renewable fuels that adversely affect programs like the renewable fuels standards program, low-carbon fuels standards and tax credits for processing certain renewable feedstocks impact our financial condition and results of operations.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Manufacturing and Operations

items.heading: Our operations are subject to planned and unplanned downtime, business interruptions, and operational hazards, any of which could adversely impact our ability to operate and could adversely impact our financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Manufacturing and Operations

items.heading: We are subject to interruptions of supply and offtake, as well as increased costs, as a result of our reliance on third-party transportation of crude oil or other feedstocks, NGL, refined petroleum and renewable fuels products.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Manufacturing and Operations

items.heading: Our investments in joint ventures decrease our ability to manage risk.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Manufacturing and Operations
